title: Fix boundary handling in interval merging
prompt: src/intervals.py contains merge_intervals(), which collapses a list of [start, end] pairs into a minimal set of non-overlapping intervals. It mishandles intervals that touch at a boundary and it assumes the input is already sorted. Fix the implementation so the existing test suite passes. Do not change the function signature.
acceptance_criteria: merge_intervals returns a sorted, minimal list of non-overlapping intervals.
Intervals that touch at a boundary (e.g. [1,3] and [3,5]) are merged.
The input list and its inner lists are not mutated.
